about.title: A teacher who builds websites.
about.body: I'm Matthew, an English teacher at an international school in Osaka and a web developer. I've built my own school's sign-in, enrollment and contract systems, and I hear every day what parents ask before they enroll.
about.nextBody: The Brightdoor school platform: sign-in, enrollment contracts and teachers' daily records in one place. Website clients get first access.

items.q: We already have a website. Can you redo it?
items.a: Yes. Start with the free review to see exactly what would change.

items.q: Do we need to write the text ourselves?
items.a: You send the details and photos, and I organize them into pages. Full copywriting is available as an extra.

items.q: Do parents need an account to book?
items.a: No. They choose a time, leave their details and send. You get the request by email.

items.q: Who owns the website and domain?
items.a: Your school owns its domain and all its content. If you leave the care plan, I’ll hand everything over.

items.q: Do you work with schools outside Osaka?
items.a: Yes. Everything happens online or by email.
